description: This file defines the Chunk data model and the ChunksService class, which handles retrieval and processing of text chunks from a vector store, including fetching sibling node texts and relevant chunks based on a query.

classes.name: Chunk
classes.description: Data model representing a text chunk with associated metadata, score, and context texts.

classes.name: ChunksService
classes.description: Service class responsible for retrieving relevant text chunks and their sibling nodes from a vector store.

methods.name: from_node
methods.description: Creates a Chunk instance from a NodeWithScore object.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ChunksService with required components and sets up storage context.

methods.name: _get_sibling_nodes_text
methods.description: Retrieves texts of sibling nodes (previous or next) relative to a given node.

methods.name: retrieve_relevant
methods.description: Retrieves relevant chunks based on input text, applying optional filters and limits.
